newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Jan-Oct budget deficit 693.3 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Jan-Oct budget deficit 693.3 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's budget deficit stood at 693.3 trillion lira in the 10 months to October, compared with 750.5 trillion in the nine months to September, the Turkish Treasury said in a statement.
The statement said revenues in the January to October period totalled 2,105.4 trillion lira, compared with spending of 2,798.7 trillion.
In 1995 as a whole the budget deficit stood at 316.6 trillion lira.
